description: Main application source file for Zephyr-based Bluetooth/IPSP sample, implementing IPv6 UDP/TCP networking with thread setup and network context management.

methods.name: tx_tcp_pool
methods.description: Returns pointer to TCP transmit buffer pool.

methods.name: data_tcp_pool
methods.description: Returns pointer to TCP data buffer pool.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Releases the quit semaphore to signal termination.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes network address, semaphore, and logs startup message.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Sets up IPv6 UDP and TCP network contexts, binds ports, and starts listening.

methods.name: build_reply
methods.description: Reads packet data and prepares reply message.

methods.name: set_dst_addr
methods.description: Sets destination address for outgoing packets based on received headers.

methods.name: udp_received
methods.description: Handles incoming UDP packets, builds reply, and sends response.

methods.name: setup_udp_recv
methods.description: Configures UDP socket to receive packets.

methods.name: tcp_received
methods.description: Handles incoming TCP packets, builds reply, and sends response.

methods.name: tcp_accepted
methods.description: Handles new TCP connection acceptance and starts receiving data.

methods.name: setup_tcp_accept
methods.description: Configures TCP socket to accept incoming connections.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Main thread function to initialize network contexts and start listening.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes app and starts listener thread.
